_comment: Plugin settings baseline for the writing-basic fixture vault (RFC-0013 plan D7).
The repository ignores `.obsidian/` and a bare `data.json` at any depth, because it lives
inside a vault, so a fixture cannot carry a committed config directory: it would be silently
absent on a clean clone and the instrument would behave differently for whoever reran it.
The seeding recipe writes this file into the scratch vault as `data.json` instead.
`apiKeysDisclaimerAccepted` and the per-provider `enabled` gates are load-bearing: without
them the view reports 'No model selected' and the composer is inert.
The seeded model is a CUSTOM entry under a cloud provider, and both halves are deliberate.
Cloud, because `validateSendRequest` refuses to send unless the model reports available, and
for a local provider that answer comes from a live LM Studio server the driver has no reason
to require. `ModelAvailabilityService.getAvailability` short-circuits every cloud provider to
'cloud' with no network call. Custom rather than catalog, because a committed fixture must
not name a curated model id that a catalog sync can later remove.
Nothing reaches Anthropic: the scripted client is installed at the `createChatClient` seam,
so the key below is a placeholder that only satisfies the enablement gate. LM Studio is
switched off so no discovery runs, which also keeps the run's console output meaningful.
`chatHistory` names the conversation the seeding recipe also writes into `conversations/`,
so the restore path resolves a real model instead of minting an empty conversation.
